# Best MagSafe car mounts (Qi2)

**Best for most iPhone owners: Belkin BoostCharge Qi2 15W Vent Mount, about $47.99**
- It includes a 27W car adapter and a USB-C cable, so nothing else is needed.
- It rotates between portrait and landscape and fits cases up to 3 mm thick.
- Vent slats must be no more than 3 mm thick and 20 mm deep. Horizontal slats work best, and vertical ones may droop.
- Belkin also makes a vent/dash version for cars with awkward vents (about $47.99).
- Where to buy: Amazon links are in https://www.cloudspress.com/best-magsafe-car-mounts-in-2026-connect-charge-and-drive/ and https://www.itechguides.com/best-magsafe-car-mounts-in-2026-connect-charge-and-drive/

**Fastest charging and best cooling: Anker Prime Qi2 25W (MagGo AirCool, A2933), $89.99**
- It has thermoelectric cooling plus a fan, which helps keep charging speed up when the phone is hot.
- It's the only pick backed by a two-year warranty. Mountguys uses it as their daily driver.
- It charges iPhone 17 and 16 Pro Max/Plus at up to 25W, but older iPhones are limited to about 15W. It doesn't work with the iPhone 16e.
- It doesn't fit Tesla or Mercedes-Benz vents, or cars without standard vent blades.
- The sources disagree on power. Mountguys and The Gadgeteer say a 60W adapter is in the box. Others say you need a 45W+ adapter. Confirm what's included before buying.
- The Gadgeteer lists it at $69.99 on sale.
- Where to buy: https://the-gadgeteer.com/2026/06/16/best-magsafe-car-mounts-iphone-2026/ and https://www.mountguys.com/best-magsafe-car-mount/

**Best value with a fan: ESR HaloLock Qi2 CryoBoost, $18.99**
- It's Qi2 15W with a fan, and it mounts on a vent or the dash.
- The car adapter isn't included, so add roughly $10–15.
- Where to buy: https://the-gadgeteer.com/2026/06/16/best-magsafe-car-mounts-iphone-2026/

**Best budget 25W: LISEN Qi2.2 25W with fan, from $39.95**
- It comes with a 95W adapter, but it has a large suction base.
- It only reaches 25W with the fan on. With the fan off it's capped at 15W.
- Where to buy: https://the-gadgeteer.com/2026/06/16/best-magsafe-car-mounts-iphone-2026/

**Cheapest: LISEN 15W MagSafe mount, $15.99**
- It has dash and vent mounting options, but it needs an 18W-per-port charger.
- The page I found didn't say whether it's Qi2-certified. Check the listing before buying, because a "MagSafe-compatible" mount without Qi2 may charge at only 7.5W.
- Where to buy: https://www.cloudspress.com/best-magsafe-car-mounts-in-2026-connect-charge-and-drive/

**Charging isn't needed: VICSEED Steel Core Vent Mount**
- It's a magnetic-only mount with a metal-core vent clip, and it's a good backup for a second car. The price wasn't listed.
- Where to buy: https://www.mountguys.com/best-magsafe-car-mount/

## Notes
- Three of the sources (RottenWiFi, iTechGuides, CloudsPress) are near-identical affiliate pages, so they aren't independent confirmation of the Belkin pick.
- Prices are from August–October 2026 and may have changed.
- The search results didn't include direct product-page links. The Amazon "Buy" buttons are on the articles linked above.
- If you tell me your phone model and vent type, I can narrow this to one pick.
